source.note: Exploratory per-process measurements on this branch while coverage reporting and rejection diagnostics were finalized. The cap algorithm and generated spec selection were unchanged. The committed generator-cap.ts reproduces the comparison at a single source version.
source.instrument: generateFrom once:true; write all selected YAML and reload it; process user plus system CPU
source.cpuScope: one generation including map load, output writes and YAML reload; fault assay excluded
source.faultScope: one deterministic every-time anywhere instance of each of the 70 validator fault classes; causal kills only; stop a class after its first witnessed kill
source.faultReuse: At 10x, caps 4096, 6126 and 6127 produce byte-identical saved suites to cap 710 and reuse its assay. All other rows have independent assays.
